FIFA faces scrutiny over US player's red card reversal after Trump call

Reports indicate FIFA suspended a red card for a US player after a call from former US President Donald Trump, sparking outrage and questions about the organization's integrity. While some outlets highlight the controversy and potential political interference, others focus on the match outcome and related player comments. FIFA has stated it backs the referee amidst the escalating tensions.
